allow_deploy.instructions: Loomplane deploys applications built from one or more repositories to clouds, from a loomplane.yaml manifest. The usual flow: analyze a project, draft or edit its manifest (save_manifest), create_plan for an environment, read the plan's actions, problems and warnings with get_plan, and then a person approves it, or approve_plan if it's offered. Problems block a plan; fix them in the manifest and plan again. Never approve a plan you haven't read.

resources.description: The JSON schema of loomplane.yaml, the manifest save_manifest takes.
resources.name: loomplane.yaml schema

tools.description: Read the project's repositories, or the ones named, and find their services, packages and resources. One analysis per repository; waits until each is done.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

ref.description: a branch, tag or commit, for one repository only; its tracked branch if empty

sources.description: the repositories to analyze, by alias; every one of the project's if empty

tools.name: analyze

tools.description: Approve a plan at the revision you reviewed, which deploys it to the cloud. Read it with get_plan first.

revision.description: the revision of the plan you reviewed, from get_plan; a plan that changed since comes back stale

tools.name: approve_plan

tools.description: Plan the project's current manifest for an environment: what deploying it would do. With from, it promotes what that environment runs instead. Waits until it's planned. Nothing changes until someone approves it.

environment.description: the environment to plan for, such as production

from.description: An environment to promote from, such as staging: the plan pins the commits it runs

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

scope.description: the repositories the plan moves, by alias; every one if empty, and the rest stay as deployed

tools.name: create_plan

tools.description: Plan an environment back to its previous successful release, saying why. Data-bearing resources and services stay as they are; the plan lists what it leaves. Waits until it's planned. Nothing changes until someone approves it.

deployment_id.description: the deployment to undo; it must be the environment's newest, which is the default

environment.description: the environment to roll back, such as production

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

reason.description: why, for the audit trail and whoever approves it

tools.name: create_rollback

tools.description: The deployment an approved plan started.
tools.name: deployment_for_plan

tools.description: A drafted loomplane.yaml from the project's latest analysis. It isn't saved.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: draft_manifest

tools.description: A deployment, step by step, with each step's status and message.
tools.name: get_deployment

tools.description: The project's current loomplane.yaml.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: get_manifest

tools.description: A plan: its actions step by step, the problems that block it, its warnings, and its revision.
tools.name: get_plan

tools.description: How a deployment is watched after it finishes: its status and verdict, the verdict on each changed service, the services it can't watch, and the rollback plan if it breached. A deployment with no watch answers not found. Unverified means missing evidence, so ask a person.
tools.name: get_release_watch

tools.description: The project's deployments, newest first.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: list_deployments

tools.description: The project's plans, newest first.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: list_plans

tools.description: The organization's projects.
tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: The project's variables. A secret's value is never shown.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: list_variables

tools.description: Reject a plan. Nothing it says happens.
tools.name: reject_plan

tools.description: Retry a failed deployment from the step that failed, with the plan that was approved.
tools.name: retry_deployment

tools.description: Save a new revision of the project's loomplane.yaml. A manifest that doesn't parse is refused with every problem and its line.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

yaml.description: the whole loomplane.yaml; the schema is the resource loomplane://schema/loomplane.yaml

tools.name: save_manifest

tools.description: Set a project variable. Services get it on their next deployment.

environment.description: one environment; every environment if empty

key.description: the variable's name, such as DATABASE_URL

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

secret.description: keep it secret: write-only, and in the cloud's secret store

service.description: one service's graph ID; every service if empty

tools.name: set_variable

tools.description: What runs each of the project's services and resources in each environment, with its address and any drift.

project.description: the project's slug, name or ID

tools.name: status

tools.description: Who the API key acts as, in which organization, and the permissions it has.
tools.name: whoami
